chars.MOHCINE: MOHCINE: a 32-year-old man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white socks.
chars.NISRINE: NISRINE: a young woman wearing a maroon satin pyjama set with white piping and a small gold bracelet.
chars.MOUNIR: MOUNIR: a man wearing a dark green bomber jacket over a black t-shirt and a thin silver chain.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night in a modern Casablanca apartment living room lit by the TV glow. MOHCINE sits on a sofa with a football match on the TV, turning his head with a suspicious frown toward NISRINE who is asleep on the other sofa; next to her head her smartphone screen lights up brightly. Tense, curious mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same living room at night. MOHCINE gently lays a soft grey blanket over NISRINE who is sleeping curled up on the sofa, a caring smile on his face. Warm lamp light.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night living room. Close view: NISRINE asleep on the sofa under a grey blanket; her smartphone lies unlocked and glowing on the coffee table in front of her. MOHCINE stands behind the coffee table staring at the glowing phone, eyebrows raised.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night living room. MOHCINE crouches beside the coffee table and slowly, secretly picks up the glowing smartphone with two fingers, glancing nervously at NISRINE sleeping on the sofa behind him. Sneaky, suspenseful mood.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night, dark living room. MOHCINE sits on the edge of the sofa holding the smartphone close to his face, the screen glow lighting his face from below; his eyes go wide and his mouth falls open in shock. The phone screen faces away from the viewer.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Split memory scene: MOHCINE in the dark living room holding the phone, shocked, while behind him a dreamy glowing thought-image shows MOUNIR, his best friend, laughing and waving. Betrayal mood, cold blue light.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Night. MOHCINE scrolls the smartphone with his thumb, sweat drops flying from his bald head, his face full of disbelief, sitting on the living room carpet next to the coffee table. The phone screen faces away from the viewer.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night living room. NISRINE moves in her sleep on the sofa, turning over under the blanket; MOHCINE freezes like a statue next to her with the smartphone hidden behind his back, eyes huge with panic. Funny awkward suspense.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: A small dark Moroccan apartment kitchen at night, only the fridge light on. MOHCINE leans against the counter holding the smartphone in one hand and pressing the other hand on his chest, his heart pounding, face pale and stunned. The phone screen faces away from the viewer.
